source: INSTAT Gabon, RGA 2022–2023, EPVA Volume 2, Tables 119–121

findings.other_tables: Province-level labour type/days/hours, seed acquisition/quality, fertilizer and phytosanitary use, livestock and equipment-use indicators are present, but not current monetary prices.

limitations: Survey observations are historical and not a current-season crop forecast.
No current provincial farmgate prices by crop, grade and unit have been validated.
No complete farmer-paid input, labour, irrigation, machinery, transport or storage budgets are available.
Plantain province values in the correction file supersede the incomplete plantain rows in the initial batch JSON.
decision: Research-only; do not activate Gabon in the calculator.
